info.name: Bus Sheba API
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for the Bus Sheba backend.

Base URL: `http://localhost:5000/api/v1` (change the `baseUrl` collection variable if needed).

Roles: PASSENGER, OPERATOR, ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN.

### How to test
1. Start the server (`npm run dev`).
2. Run `Register Passenger`, then `Verify Email` (uses the OTP emailed to you). OR log in with an existing account.
3. Login / Verify-Email automatically save the returned `accessToken` into the collection variable, and every protected request uses the `{{accessToken}}` Bearer token.
4. For ADMIN routes use the seeded super admin / tester admin credentials. For OPERATOR routes apply as operator (multipart), verify, then have an admin approve it.

### Variables
UUID placeholders (`{{busId}}`, `{{routeId}}`, etc.) hold example UUIDs - replace them with real IDs returned by list endpoints.

request.description: Public. Creates a passenger account and sends a 6-digit OTP to the email. Password needs: 8+ chars, 1 uppercase, 1 lowercase, 1 number, 1 special character.
Public. OTP must be exactly 6 characters (the one emailed during registration). On success the access token is stored in the `accessToken` collection variable.

Public. Works for any verified role (PASSENGER / OPERATOR / ADMIN / SUPER_ADMIN). Sets httpOnly cookies and returns tokens in the body; the test script stores the access token for subsequent requests.
Public. Requires a valid Google ID token.
Public. Sends a 6-digit OTP to the email for password reset.
Public. OTP is exactly 6 characters; the new password follows the standard strong-password rules.
Any logged-in user.
Any logged-in user. multipart/form-data: the `data` text field holds the JSON body (name/phone optional), the `image` file field is optional (JPEG/PNG/WebP, max 5MB).
Any logged-in user. Returns the current user profile.
Public. Reads the `refreshToken` httpOnly cookie (set by login/verify-email) and issues a fresh token pair.
Public. multipart/form-data: `data` text field holds JSON `{user, operator}`; file fields `nidDocument` (1), `tradeLicenseDocument` (1), `additionalDocuments` (up to 3).
Public. OTP is exactly 6 characters, sent to the operator's email after applying.
ADMIN / SUPER_ADMIN. `verificationStatus` is APPROVED or REJECTED. `rejectReason` optional (use when REJECTED).
OPERATOR (logged-in operator updates their own profile). All fields optional.
ADMIN / SUPER_ADMIN. Query filters: `searchTerm`, `page`, `limit`, `sortBy`, `sortOrder`.
OPERATOR. `busType`: AC | NON_AC | SLEEPER | SEMI_SLEEPER. `seatLayout`: TWO_BY_TWO | ONE_BY_TWO | TWO_BY_ONE (optional). `totalSeats` 10-100. `registrationNo` format: e.g. DHAKA-METRO-HA-11-2233.
OPERATOR. All fields optional.
OPERATOR. Sets bus status to INACTIVE.
OPERATOR. Sets bus status to ACTIVE.
OPERATOR. Sets bus status to MAINTENANCE.
OPERATOR. Paginated list of the logged-in operator's buses.
Public. Query filters: `searchTerm`, `page`, `limit`, `sortBy`, `sortOrder`, `busType`, `status` (ACTIVE|INACTIVE|MAINTENANCE), `companyName`, `operatorEmail`, `minSeats`, `maxSeats`, `totalSeats`.
Public. All buses belonging to an operator.
Public. Seat layout of a bus.
Public. Bus details with operator, seats and upcoming trips.
ADMIN / SUPER_ADMIN. `routeStops` optional. Note `departureMinutes` must be >= `arrivalMinutes` for every stop.
ADMIN / SUPER_ADMIN. All fields optional.
ADMIN / SUPER_ADMIN. Soft-deactivates the route.
ADMIN / SUPER_ADMIN. Re-activates the route.
Public. Query filters: `searchTerm`, `page`, `limit`, `sortBy`, `sortOrder`, `source`, `destination`, `isActive` (true|false), `minDistance`, `maxDistance`.
Public. Path params: `source` / `destination`.
Public. Route details including stops.
ADMIN / SUPER_ADMIN. `stopOrder` starts at 1; `departureMinutes` must be >= `arrivalMinutes`.
ADMIN / SUPER_ADMIN. Request body is a JSON ARRAY of the stop objects above.
ADMIN / SUPER_ADMIN. All fields optional.
ADMIN / SUPER_ADMIN. Soft-deletes the stop.
ADMIN / SUPER_ADMIN. Restores a soft-deleted stop.
Public. Query filters: `page`, `limit`, `sortBy`, `sortOrder`, `routeId`, `isDeleted`.
Public. Ordered stops of a route.
Public. Single stop details.
OPERATOR. Dates are ISO date/time strings (coerced). `departureTime` must be in the future, `arrivalTime` after `departureTime`. `fare` 1-50000.
OPERATOR. All fields optional; same validation rules as create.
OPERATOR. Cancels the trip.
OPERATOR / ADMIN / SUPER_ADMIN. `status`: SCHEDULED | BOARDING | DEPARTED | COMPLETED | CANCELLED.
OPERATOR. Filters: `page`, `limit`, `sortBy`, `sortOrder`, `status`, `travelDate` (YYYY-MM-DD), `source`, `destination`.
Public. `source` and `destination` are required. `travelDate` optional (YYYY-MM-DD). Returns only SCHEDULED future trips on active routes with active buses.
Public. Filters: `searchTerm`, `page`, `limit`, `sortBy`, `sortOrder`, `source`, `destination`, `travelDate`, `busType` (AC|NON_AC|SLEEPER|SEMI_SLEEPER), `status`, `minFare`, `maxFare`.
Public. Optional `status`: AVAILABLE | HELD | BOOKED | BLOCKED.
Public. `fromStopId` and `toStopId` optional; when provided are used for segment-overlap seat availability. Returns `availableSeats` and `totalAvailable`.
Public. Full trip details with bus, operator, route stops and trip seats.
PASSENGER. `tripSeatIds` are the TripSeat IDs (not Bus seat IDs) - get them from `available-seats`. Number of passengers must equal number of seats. Seats are HELD for 15 minutes (`expiresAt`).
PASSENGER. Filters: `page`, `limit`, `sortBy`, `sortOrder`, `status` (PENDING|CONFIRMED|CANCELLED|COMPLETED|EXPIRED).
ADMIN / SUPER_ADMIN. Filters: `searchTerm` (bookingNumber), `page`, `limit`, `sortBy`, `sortOrder`, `status`, `travelDate` (YYYY-MM-DD).
PASSENGER / ADMIN / SUPER_ADMIN. Passengers may only access their own bookings; admins see any.
PASSENGER. Initializes a bKash payment for a PENDING booking owned by the user. Returns a `paymentUrl` (bKash checkout URL).

Public (called by bKash). On success: confirms booking, marks seats BOOKED, creates ticket, uploads PDF, emails the user, then redirects to the frontend. Requires the `paymentID` variable (captured from the bKash redirect).
PASSENGER. Filters: `page`, `limit`, `sortBy`, `sortOrder`, `bookingId`, `status`, `minAmount`, `maxAmount`.
ADMIN / SUPER_ADMIN. Filters: `page`, `limit`, `sortBy`, `sortOrder`, `bookingId`, `status`, `minAmount`, `maxAmount`.
PASSENGER / ADMIN / SUPER_ADMIN. Passengers may only access payments of their own bookings.
ADMIN / SUPER_ADMIN. Platform-wide analytics.
OPERATOR. Scoped to the logged-in operator.
PASSENGER. Scoped to the logged-in passenger.
